eg-1hsl.title: Coverage: sparse Gen 3 trekkers only
eg-1hsl.summary: All coverage is the older Gen 3 camera carried on foot: low to the ground, small blur, no car shadow. There are seven spots at historic sites, four around the capital and three near the northern coast.

eg-98pq.title: Landmark: grey-domed mosque, tall minarets
eg-98pq.summary: Inside the citadel, a mosque with light grey domes and very tall minarets. It looks a bit like Hagia Sophia in Istanbul.

differs.how: Hagia Sophia only looks similar; this mosque has very tall minarets

eg-Ehp5.title: Houses: sandstone buildings
eg-Ehp5.summary: Many buildings in the trekker coverage are made of sandstone.

eg-JJUF.title: Landmark: castle with thick sandstone walls
eg-JJUF.summary: A large sandstone castle surrounded by thick sandstone walls.

eg-Ogus.title: Landmark: rows of square pillars
eg-Ogus.summary: Inside a valley temple near the pyramids, rows of massive square pillars.

eg-PQtH.title: Houses: monastery with cross-topped spires
eg-PQtH.summary: A monastery complex of several large, palace-like buildings in a modern Arabic style, most with spires topped by Christian crosses.

eg-PyuJ.title: Landmark: huge fort, clean-cut stone walls
eg-PyuJ.summary: An enormous fortress with massive walls of clean-cut sandstone blocks, where a trekker walks through and around.

eg-iib2.title: Coverage: church complex on a busy street
eg-iib2.summary: Outside a church, the trekker walks a normal city street with apartment blocks, shops and pedestrians. You still see the church's cross-topped spires and old sandstone walls. It is just east of Giza.

eg-mL36.title: Landmark: big dig site, yellow wooden chapel
eg-mL36.summary: A major excavation area southwest of the northern coast city, just south of the monastery, with a small yellow wooden chapel in the middle.

eg-o3jY.title: Landmark: stepped pyramid with scaffolding
eg-o3jY.summary: South of the capital, a pyramid with stair-like sections and scaffolding around it. Nearby are minor dig sites and plain desert.

eg-vPJa.title: Language: Arabic script
eg-vPJa.summary: Arabic appears on a few signs. You can spot the script by its lines and dots.

eg-x6jB.title: Landmark: church courtyard with mosaics
eg-x6jB.summary: Inside the church, a beautiful courtyard with religious mosaics and two white spires.

eg-xI89.title: Landmark: great pyramids
eg-xI89.summary: The big sandstone pyramids have trekker coverage. Do not confuse them with the glass pyramid at Memphis.
